title: Protein Extraction Protocol
author: Ashley Seifert
materials: Homogenize the dislodged tissue using sonicator.

steps.title: Prepare Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Set the centrifuge to 4°C before starting the procedure.

steps.title: Harvest and Freeze Tissue
steps.instruction: Collect tissue samples from anesthetized animals and prepare for storage.

substeps.instruction: Dissect a 4mm punch of tissue.
Hold tissue in forceps and rinse quickly in HBSS/PBS.
Transfer tissue into a freshly labelled 1.5ml Eppendorf tube.
Snap freeze in liquid nitrogen.
Transport to lab and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Prepare Cold Extraction Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the protein extraction buffer by adding inhibitors to RIPA buffer.

substeps.instruction: To 1ml of RIPA buffer, freshly add 10ul each of protease inhibitor cocktail, Na-orthovanadate, and PMSF.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Extract proteins from the frozen tissue samples on ice.

substeps.instruction: Remove collected tissue from -80°C freeze and keep in an ice bucket.
Add 200-400ul of cold protein extraction buffer per sample.
Use a manual homogenizer to dislodge the tissue (10-15 times).
Return samples to ice.

steps.title: Prepare Sonicator
steps.instruction: Set up the sonicator and perform initial cleaning.

substeps.instruction: Prepare one 15ml falcon of DI water and one 15ml falcon of 70% ethanol.
Set sonicator conditions: Pulse-Continues, Control cycle-4, and duty cycle-40%.
Wash the sonicator twice with 70% ethanol (10 sec each), followed by twice with DI water (10 sec each).

steps.title: Sonicate Protein Samples
steps.instruction: Sonicate the protein samples and maintain cleanliness between runs.

substeps.instruction: Sonicate each protein sample 3 times with a 20-25 sec pulse, followed by 30 sec in ice.
Between samples, wash the sonicator with water followed by 70% ethanol for 5 sec each.

steps.title: Clean Sonicator
steps.instruction: Perform final cleaning of the sonicator after all samples are processed.

substeps.instruction: Wash the sonicator twice with DI water (10 sec each), followed by twice with 70% ethanol (10 sec each).

steps.title: Centrifuge and Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Separate the protein extract from the cellular debris.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at 13,000 rpm for 15 min at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant in freshly labelled 1.5ml Eppendorf tubes.
Store at -80°C or proceed to protein quantification.

steps.title: Quantify Protein Concentration
steps.instruction: Perform protein estimation using a 96-well plate and BSA standards.

substeps.instruction: Add BSA standards of different concentrations (2.5ug, 5ug, 10ug, 20ug, and 40ug) to a 96-well plate.
Load protein samples in triplicates at 2ul or 5ul per well.
Add 100ul of BSA reagent to each well.
Read the plate according to the saved protein estimation protocol to calculate estimated protein for western blot.
